cohort: 38 patients who underwent conservative management with hypogastric artery ligation and endo-uterine hemostatic suture to control postpartum hemorrhage secondary to placenta previa-accreta
finding: Conservative treatment of postpartum hemorrhage secondary to placenta previa-accreta with hypogastric artery ligation and endo-uterine hemostatic sutures to the lower segment of the uterus is associated with a lower hysterectomy rate compared with other conservative methods reported in the literature.
gest_age: 68.5% of the cohort had preterm delivery
